## Directory

### Coding & Vibe Coding
- [Cursor](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/cursor): AI-first code editor with agent mode, codebase chat and tab completion. Pricing: Paid plans from $8/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [Bolt.new](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/bolt-new): Prompt, run, edit and deploy full-stack web apps right in your browser. Pricing: Pro from $25/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [v0](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/v0): Vercel's AI app builder that turns prompts into React/Next.js apps and UI. Pricing: Plus from $30/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [Lovable](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/lovable): Build full-stack web apps by chatting with an AI engineer. Pricing: Pro from $25/mo ($21/mo billed annually); free plan has 5 daily credits. Free tier: yes.
- [Replit](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/replit): Browser IDE with Replit Agent that builds and deploys apps from a prompt. Pricing: Core from $20/mo ($18/mo billed annually). Free tier: yes.
- [GitHub Copilot](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/github-copilot): AI pair programmer and coding agent inside VS Code, JetBrains and GitHub. Pricing: Pro from $10/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [Devin](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/devin): Cognition's coding agents: Devin Desktop (the editor formerly called Windsurf) plus Devin cloud agents. Pricing: Pro from $20/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [Zed](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/zed): Fast open-source code editor with AI edit predictions, an agent panel and bring-your-own-key support. Pricing: Pro from $10/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [OpenRouter](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/openrouter): One OpenAI-compatible API for 500+ models from 80+ providers, with fallback routing. Pricing: Pay-as-you-go; 5.5% fee on credit purchases. Free tier: yes.
- [Muse Spark Open (Meta)](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/muse-spark-open-meta): Meta's open-weight multimodal MoE model (816B total, 42B active, 1M context) built for coding and agent work. Released Oct 15, 2026. Pricing: Free open weights (Muse Model License); hosted via OpenRouter, Groq, Together and others. Free tier: yes.
- [NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/nvidia-nemotron-3-5-bolt): NVIDIA's open local model (74B total, 9B active, 256K context) for coding, reasoning, vision and tool use. Fits about 24GB of GPU memory via Ollama, llama.cpp or LM Studio (NVIDIA GPUs; no Apple silicon yet). Released Oct 15, 2026. Pricing: Free open weights (OpenMDW License 1.1). Free tier: yes.
- [OpenCode](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/opencode): Open-source AI coding agent for the terminal, desktop app and IDE. Use its free included models, connect 75+ providers (including local models), or sign in with GitHub Copilot or ChatGPT Plus/Pro. Security note: on Oct 17, 2026 OpenCode disclosed a breach of a legacy system behind its hosted Console that may have exposed provider API keys saved in Console workspaces (1.4% of Console users, all notified by email). Keys you add locally in the CLI or desktop app weren't part of it; if you were notified, revoke and replace those keys at each provider. Pricing: Open source (MIT); optional Zen pay-as-you-go models. Free tier: yes.
- [Hugging Face](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/hugging-face): The hub for open models, datasets and Spaces demos, plus hosted inference. Pricing: PRO from $9/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [Claude Code](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/claude-code): Anthropic's agentic coding tool for the terminal, IDE and web. Pricing: Included with paid Claude plans.
- [OpenAI Codex](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/openai-codex): OpenAI's coding agent for the CLI, IDE and cloud tasks. Pricing: Included with ChatGPT plans (limited on Free and Go). Free tier: yes.
- [Warp](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/warp): Agentic terminal and development environment with built-in AI agents. Pricing: Build from $20/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [Cline](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/cline): Open-source autonomous coding agent for VS Code. Pricing: Open source.
- [Aider](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/aider): Open-source AI pair programming in your terminal, with git integration. Pricing: Open source.

### Chat Assistants
- [ChatGPT](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/chatgpt): OpenAI's general-purpose AI assistant for chat, writing, code and images. Pricing: Plus $20/mo; lower-cost Go plan also available. Free tier: yes.
- [Claude](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/claude): Anthropic's AI assistant for writing, analysis and coding. Pricing: Pro from $17/mo billed annually ($20 monthly). Free tier: yes.
- [Gemini](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/gemini): Google's AI assistant, connected to Google apps and search. For work, the new Gemini agent (Oct 8, 2026) runs inside Gmail, Docs, Sheets and Calendar. Pricing: Google AI Plus from $4.99/mo (US). Free tier: yes.
- [Grok](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/grok): xAI's AI assistant with real-time knowledge from X and the web. Pricing: Free on the web and in the apps; SuperGrok paid upgrade for higher limits. Free tier: yes.
- [Microsoft Copilot](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/microsoft-copilot): Microsoft's AI companion for chat, search and creation.
- [Le Chat (Mistral)](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/le-chat-mistral): Mistral AI's chat assistant, with Mistral Vibe for coding in the CLI, IDE or web. Pricing: Pro from $14.99/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [Ollama](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/ollama): Run open models locally with one command, or use Ollama's cloud models when your machine isn't enough. Pricing: Paid plans from $20/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [LM Studio](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/lm-studio): Desktop app (now with the Bionic agent) for downloading and running local LLMs via llama.cpp and MLX. Pricing: Bionic+ from $20/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [DeepSeek](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/deepseek): Chat assistant powered by DeepSeek's open-weight models.

### Image
- [Midjourney](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/midjourney): AI image and video generator known for its distinctive artistic style. Pricing: Basic from $10/mo ($8/mo billed annually).
- [Ideogram](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/ideogram): AI image generator that's strong at rendering text in images. Pricing: Plus from $15/mo billed annually ($20 monthly). Free tier: yes.
- [Leonardo.Ai](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/leonardo-ai): AI image and video generation platform for creators and game assets. Pricing: Essential from $12/mo; free plan has 150 tokens/day. Free tier: yes.
- [Krea](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/krea): Real-time AI image and video generation and enhancement. Pricing: Pro from $21/mo billed yearly ($35 monthly). Free tier: yes.
- [Adobe Firefly](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/adobe-firefly): Adobe's generative AI for images, video and design, built into Creative Cloud.
- [Black Forest Labs (FLUX)](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/black-forest-labs-flux): Makers of the FLUX image models, including FLUX 3 Image Klein (Oct 15, 2026): open weights, native 4K, runs on consumer GPUs. Pricing: API from $0.009/image (FLUX 3 Image Klein at 1K); open weights free for individuals and companies under $5M revenue. Free tier: yes.
- [InvokeAI](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/invokeai): Free, open-source AI image studio you run on your own GPU: a unified canvas for inpainting and outpainting, node-based workflows and a gallery, with support for SDXL, SD 3.5, FLUX.1, FLUX.2, Qwen Image and more. About 28,700 GitHub stars; v7.0 is in alpha. Pricing: Open source (Apache-2.0).
- [Recraft](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/recraft): AI image generator for designers, with vector and brand-style output. Free tier: yes.

### AI for IT & Cybersecurity
- [TryHackMe (Echo)](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/tryhackme-echo): Hands-on cyber training labs with Echo, a built-in AI tutor that gives context-aware hints without handing you the answer.
- [HTB Academy (HTB Coach)](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/htb-academy-htb-coach): Hack The Box's training modules with HTB Coach (beta): AI explanations, section summaries and quizzes tied to what you're studying.
- [PentestGPT](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/pentestgpt): Open-source autonomous pentesting agent from USENIX Security 2024 research, with staged recon-to-exploit runs for CTFs and lab targets. Pricing: Open source (MIT).
- [Burp AI (PortSwigger)](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/burp-ai-portswigger): AI pentesting partner built into Repeater in Burp Suite Professional for validating findings and cutting scan noise.
- [Snyk](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/snyk): Developer security platform that scans your code, open-source dependencies, containers and IaC from the IDE, CLI and repos. Pricing: Team from $25/mo (up to 10 developers). Free tier: yes.
- [Semgrep](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/semgrep): Fast code scanner (SAST, supply chain, secrets) with AI-powered detection, triage and autofix. Great for scanning your own home-lab scripts. Pricing: Free for up to 10 contributors (60 AI credits); Teams Code from $30/contributor/mo. Free tier: yes.
- [GitHub Copilot Autofix](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/github-copilot-autofix): AI fixes for CodeQL code scanning alerts. Agentic autofix (GA Oct 15, 2026) investigates alerts and opens a draft PR with a validated fix. Pricing: Free on public repos; private repos need GitHub Code Security. Free tier: yes.
- [VirusTotal Code Insight](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/virustotal-code-insight): AI summaries in VirusTotal that explain what a suspicious script (starting with PowerShell) or decompiled code actually does. Handy for malware-analysis practice. Pricing: Free for community users on eligible uploads; Code Insight API limited to 50 requests/day. Free tier: yes.
- [Tines](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/tines): Security and IT workflow automation (SOAR) with built-in AI and bring-your-own-model support, used by SOC and IT teams. Pricing: Free edition: 3 live workflows + one-time $50 AI allowance; paid editions on request. Free tier: yes.
- [SentinelOne Purple AI](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/sentinelone-purple-ai): Agentic AI security analyst in the SentinelOne Singularity Platform: ask questions in plain English, auto-triage alerts and run guided investigations.
- [Wazuh](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/wazuh): Free, open-source SIEM and XDR used by home labbers and SOC teams for log analysis, threat detection and compliance. Wazuh documents AI threat hunting with local models via Ollama, and Wazuh 5.0 (now in release candidate) adds a built-in AI Assistant. Pricing: Free and open source (self-hosted); Wazuh Cloud is a paid hosted option. Free tier: yes.
- [CyberStrikeAI](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/cyberstrikeai): Open-source AI pentesting platform written in Go: agents run 100+ security tools over MCP, with human approval steps, audit logs and CTF roles. Only for labs and systems you're authorized to test. Pricing: Open source (Apache-2.0).
- [Sophos AI Defense](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/sophos-ai-defense): Finds the AI tools employees and apps are using, including unapproved shadow AI, and enforces real-time guardrails on prompts and data across endpoint, network, identity and browser. Generally available Oct 16, 2026. Pricing: Quote-based add-on for Sophos EDR, XDR and MDR customers.
- [garak (NVIDIA)](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/garak-nvidia): NVIDIA's open-source LLM vulnerability scanner: probes chatbots and AI apps for prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucination and toxicity, then reports what got through. v0.17.1 shipped Oct 16, 2026. Pricing: Open source (Apache-2.0).
- [Atera](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/atera): All-in-one IT management (RMM, help desk, ticketing and patching) priced per technician, with AI Copilot built into every plan for scripts, ticket summaries and knowledge-base drafts. Robin, its end-user AI agent, is sold separately. Pricing: Professional from $149/technician/mo billed annually ($169 monthly); 30-day free trial.
- [Security Onion](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/security-onion): Free and open platform for threat hunting, network security monitoring and log management (2+ million downloads), a staple of SOC home labs. Security Onion 3 shipped in 2026. Onion AI, its assistant for alert analysis and detection tuning (now with local model support), comes with Security Onion Pro. Pricing: Free and open; Onion AI is part of Security Onion Pro (contact sales). Free tier: yes.
- [promptfoo](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/promptfoo): Open-source CLI for testing and red-teaming LLM apps and agents: write evals in YAML, compare models side by side and scan for prompt injection, jailbreaks and data leaks. About 26,000 GitHub stars; the site says 300,000+ developers use it. Pricing: Community edition free and open source (MIT), red teaming up to 10k probes/mo; Enterprise custom. Free tier: yes.
- [Nuclei (ProjectDiscovery)](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/nuclei-projectdiscovery): Fast open-source vulnerability scanner built on thousands of community YAML templates, with an -ai option that generates and runs a template from a plain-English prompt. About 32,000 GitHub stars. Only scan systems you own or are authorized to test. Pricing: Open source (MIT); free AI template editor on ProjectDiscovery Cloud.
- [Freshservice](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/freshservice): Cloud IT service desk (ITSM) from Freshworks: ticket and incident queues, knowledge base, self-service portal and service catalog, with Freddy AI Copilot as an add-on. A common help desk platform you can practice on with the free trial. Pricing: Starter from $19/agent/mo billed annually; Freddy AI Copilot add-on $29/agent/mo; free trial.
- [Microsoft Security Copilot](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/microsoft-security-copilot): Generative AI for security teams across Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, Entra, Intune and Purview: summarize incidents, write queries and reverse-engineer malicious scripts in plain English. Pricing: Pay-as-you-go: $4 per provisioned SCU/hour.
- [Google Security Operations](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/google-security-operations): Google's SecOps platform (SIEM + SOAR) with Gemini for natural-language search, detection writing and investigation.
- [CrowdStrike Charlotte AI](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/crowdstrike-charlotte-ai): Agentic security analyst in the CrowdStrike platform that triages detections and speeds up investigations.
- [Splunk AI Assistant](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/splunk-ai-assistant): Natural-language assistant in Splunk for finding dashboards, reports and data and getting help with searches over your logs. Pricing: No additional fee for Splunk Cloud Platform and Splunk Enterprise customers.
- [Elastic Security AI](https://aitrackertool.dev/tools/elastic-security-ai): AI in Elastic Security: automated alert triage and hypothesis-driven threat hunts with ES|QL over your SIEM data. Pricing: Elastic AI Assistant included in Serverless Security Analytics Complete, from $0.11/GB ingested plus retention.
